verdict.rationale: Any service that collects filer data, including a state business-filing agency, could plausibly publish an AI-training opt-out or data-use policy, so this axis applies. The evidence pack contains nothing about AI training or user data-use controls. The Business Express robots.txt 'Disallow: /' governs crawler access to the portal, not a user's ability to exclude their own data from model training, so it is an adjacent control and earns no credit.
